Cost: 250eb (Expensive)
Type: External Body Cyberware
Install: Hospital
Humanity Loss: 3 (1d6)
Option Slots: uses 1

External Body Cyberware. Borgware. Replaces the mouth and nose with a hot-swappable plated facemask. Works as an installation of Nasal Filters, and anyone making a Human Perception check against the user takes -2. Incompatible with the Advanced Cyber-Jaw. Extra faceplates come in nearly any style, from bright pink to gunmetal to an animal snout, at 50eb (Costly) each.

Foundry notes:

  • Counts as Borgware for Maximum Humanity Loss; the sheet doesn't track that, so apply it by hand.
  • The -2 applies to other people's checks, so it can't be automated from this item.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > External Body Cyberware).
